summary: Architecture and design evidence for the Post-Service Observability Report: a pure, read-only aggregation of data this application already captures during a live service, plus a labeled process-lifetime diagnostics snapshot.
constraintDrivingDesign: The operator's own roadmap synthesis named 'Reliability & Trust' as the Phase 5 theme, with a post-service summary as the smallest, lowest-risk, immediately-useful slice - mirroring how Phase 3.9 (Sermon Harvest) was scoped: no new detection logic, no new AI, no new persistence.
dataSourcesAudited: Suggestion / SuggestionStatus (core/ai) - already persisted per service via persistence::list_suggestions
scripture_detections.detection_type (via ReferenceKind::label()) - already persisted per service, read via a new GROUP BY count query
audit_events.category (timeline.rs) - already persisted per service, read via a new GROUP BY count query
ServiceSession (core/service) - already persisted, read via persistence::get_service
SpeechDiagnostics / EmbeddingDiagnostics (state.rs AppState fields) - already tracked, process-lifetime, read via a cloned snapshot

designDecisions.pureAggregationNoNewDetection: service_report.rs contains zero detection/classification logic - it only calls existing persistence/timeline read functions and reads AppState's existing diagnostics structs, mirroring harvest.rs's own discipline exactly.
designDecisions.groupByNotRowDump: persistence::scripture_detection_kind_counts and timeline::count_events_by_category return (String, u64) pairs via SQL GROUP BY, not full row lists - a long service's detections/timeline rows can run into the hundreds or thousands; the report only ever needs totals per kind/category.
designDecisions.liveDiagnosticsHonestlyScoped: SpeechDiagnostics/EmbeddingDiagnostics are AppState fields that accumulate across every start_listening call in one run of the app, never reset per service (see state.rs's own docs on those fields). LiveDiagnosticsSnapshot's field names and this module's own doc comment say 'since app launch,' never claiming false service-scoped precision - consistent with this project's standing Environment A/B/C discipline against inflated software-only readings.
designDecisions.avgInferenceDurationDerivation: avg_inference_duration_ms is derived as inference_duration_ms_sum / inference_duration_samples when samples > 0 else None - copied verbatim from commands::get_pilot_diagnostics's own existing derivation, verified identical via a dedicated test (live_diagnostics_average_inference_duration_matches_get_pilot_diagnostics_derivation) so the two can never silently drift apart.
designDecisions.durationNoneWhileActive: duration_minutes is None whenever a service has no ended_at yet - never a guessed/partial duration for an in-progress service, verified by duration_is_none_for_a_still_active_service.

concurrencyAndFailureIsolation: get_service_report locks state.db only for the duration of its own read queries (mirroring every other read command in commands.rs), and clones speech_diagnostics/embedding_diagnostics under their own short-lived locks before calling build_service_report - it never holds two AppState mutexes at once. On the frontend, HistoryView.tsx fetches the report in a separate .then()/.catch() from the existing Promise.all for timeline/transcript/suggestions/presentations/saved content, so a report failure (e.g. an older service predating this phase, or any backend error) never blocks the rest of the History view from loading.
testCoverageSummary: 8 unit tests in service_report.rs: suggestion-status breakdown, detection-kind breakdown, active-vs-ended duration (both branches), the avg_inference_duration_ms derivation matching get_pilot_diagnostics's own (both the populated and zero-sample cases), timeline-category counts reflecting recorded events, and service-scoping isolation (a report for service A never reflects service B's data). Plus 2 frontend tests in commands.test.ts proving the Tauri-runtime IPC guard on getServiceReport.
regressionResult: cargo fmt --check clean. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean under both default features and --features whisper,semantic-search. cargo test --workspace (single-threaded, to avoid a pre-existing, unrelated config.rs env-var test-parallelism flake) fully green under both feature configurations; cip-desktop alone gained 8 new tests, all in service_report.rs, all passing (297/297 total). Frontend: npm run typecheck clean, npm run lint clean (no new warnings), npm run test 220/220 passing (218 pre-existing + 2 new), npm run build succeeds.
